reader.requirement: For a relative file in random or dynamic access mode, REWRITE must replace the record whose relative record number is the RELATIVE KEY's content (no prior READ needed); when no such record exists (a gap, a deleted record, key zero, a key past the last record) the invalid key condition exists, the file is not updated, the record area is unchanged and the I-O status is set (23 per VIII.1.3.4).

edition-consulted.switches: passes ctx.Data.DialectLevel to the relative connector as FileConnector.Edition
DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility (from 2002): at 85 the store is attached without sharing arbitration; the REWRITE body and its 23 arm are the same code

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectBehavior|CobolVersion over RelativeConnector.cs, FileConnector.cs, FileRegistry.cs, KeyedIoEmitter.cs, SequentialIoEmitter.cs, EcEmitter.cs; RelativeConnector#Rewrite itself consults no edition (the only DialectBehavior in the file is RelativeWriteKeyOutOfRangeIsPermanentError in Write).

reader.notes: The emitter stores the RELATIVE KEY into the connector (FileSetRelativeKey) for non-sequential access, and RelativeConnector.Rewrite replaces _pendingKey's slot or answers 23 before touching the store; the record area is never written by the statement, so it is unaffected. Identical output at --std 2023 is not required for a CONFORMS verdict; the code path has no edition arm.

refuter.evidence: Probe refute-1985-136/g13b.cob at --std 85 (runs/g13b-001), RANDOM access with a PIC 9(9) COMP relative key: REWRITE of a record WRITTEN in the same open -> 'K7 OK 00'; after DELETE of 5, REWRITE key 5 -> 'K5 INV 23', area 'NEW-05' unaffected; READ 2 then REWRITE with key moved to 1 (gap) -> 'K1 INV 23' and record 2 untouched until the keyed REWRITE 'K2 OK 00' with no READ; key 999999999 -> 'KBIG INV 23'; OPTIONAL file absent, OPEN I-O '05' (created), REWRITE -> 'KO INV 23'; reread: only 2 NEW-02 and 7 NEW-07 exist.
